title: Text: DET Michele Wysocki ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Ben didn't include the Heimlich question on the "official transcript" of last night's conference call
I saw that. Unfortunately I had no part of that, probably a Ron question.
Oh I figured you didn't
[Attachment: Image]
[Attachment: Image]
He's flying, so you might not hear back for a while
I already got a snarky answer
Oh wow
"Could barely hear you on the call. Were you driving with the top down? Glad you could hear his response."
I just dislike Ben, is what it comes down to. How's it going there
Haha. Feel ya. Things here are good. These next two days will be pie, so I'm going to take it as that and try to slow life down.
"For the record, I have asked to have your last question included, and resent to our local media group."
Send it, Ben!!!!
Lol so he did that on his own, Ron didn't tell him to not include it.
Oh totally
That's what pissed me off about it
"I did not know it was omitted. It was not requested to be. It was hard to hear you on the call."
It was hard to hear you to be fair, but that doesn't mean I'm needed to be excluded. I'm over his decision making on his own, I'm just focusing on what I can control and doing my best.
Yeah
And I'm just a dick that wanted to point that out to Ron
I mean it was your question, makes sense you asked why it wasn't included
